Markets.title: US stocks: Tech selloff weighs down Wall Street as bond yields climb
Markets.summary: Rising bond yields and Middle East tensions caused US stocks and technology shares to drop on Wall Street. During this market downturn, investors shifted toward safer sectors like healthcare while oil prices increased.

Markets.title: Anthropic pre-IPO credit facility set to climb past $10 billion
Markets.summary: AI startup Anthropic is expanding its pre-IPO revolving credit facility beyond $10 billion to prepare for a public market debut this fall. The company is seeing strong participation from multiple banks eager to secure roles in the upcoming offering amid surging revenue.

Markets.title: Gaja Alternative Asset Management mobilises Rs 165 crore from anchor investors
Markets.summary: Gaja Alternative Asset Management raised Rs 165 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 550 crore initial public offering opening on Wednesday. The IPO proceeds will be used for debt repayment, new fund seeding, and general corporate needs, with shares scheduled to list on August 26.

Markets.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank raises $650 million in debut dollar bond sale
Markets.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank raised $650 million in its first-ever five-year dollar bond sale. Strong investor demand from Asia and Europe allowed the bank to tighten pricing after orders reached $2.1 billion.

Markets.title: Sebi to soon float consultation paper on distribution framework for corporate bonds
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi plans to release a consultation paper to refine the distribution framework for corporate bonds. The initiative aims to broaden debt market participation and improve retail investor access to privately placed bonds through online platforms.

Markets.title: Sakarni Plaster to invest Rs 450 cr on expansion; to set up 2 building material plants
Markets.summary: Sakarni Plaster plans to invest Rs 450 crore over the next two years to build two new manufacturing plants and expand existing facilities. The funds, sourced from internal accruals and bank loans, will support the production of gypsum boards and paints to meet rising demand.

Geo-Political.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, court hears
Geo-Political.summary: A trial has begun in a major US states lawsuit alleging Meta deliberately hooked children on Facebook and Instagram. Meta defended itself in court by arguing that social media addiction does not exist.

Geo-Political.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
Geo-Political.summary: Russia has accused the UK of escalating the war in Ukraine by supplying British-made drones. In response, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that the UK fully supports Kyiv.

Geo-Political.title: Earthquake rocks Spain's historic Granada, injuring three
Geo-Political.summary: An earthquake struck the historic Spanish city of Granada, injuring three people and damaging various buildings and cars. The world-famous Alhambra palace temporarily closed following the tremor.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil's President Lula hails oil discovery near Amazon river
Geo-Political.summary: Brazilian President Lula has praised a new oil discovery in the sea off the mouth of the Amazon River. Environmentalists have strongly criticized the exploratory drilling that led to this find.

Geo-Political.title: Kariba ferry death toll rises to 93, making it Zimbabwe's deadliest transport disaster
Geo-Political.summary: The death toll from a ferry disaster on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe has risen to 93 victims. This incident is officially recorded as the country's deadliest transport disaster as recovery operations continue.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course on the subject. The author achieved this visibility without using paid advertising.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines the top 10 AI tools designed to help digital creators level up their content creation in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing the industry and making the content creation process easier.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth forecast to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that ongoing downside risks include the West Asia war, high inflation, currency depreciation, and lower-than-anticipated capital expenditure.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is accelerating agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes and consumption. This strategy aims to counteract the negative economic impacts of El Nino and a weak monsoon on the rural sector.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research predicts India will achieve a $50 billion balance of payments surplus for FY27. This financial surplus is expected to be driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: Although the overall monsoon rainfall deficit has decreased to 13%, erratic weather patterns have caused severe regional imbalances. These variations include a mix of intense deluges and prolonged dry spells across the Southwest.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is considering the removal of performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) receiving government contracts. This change is notable because MSMEs represented half of the central government's ₹2.30 trillion procurement in FY26, which currently requires them to furnish guarantees worth 3-10% of project values exceeding ₹100,000.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: India's overall unemployment rate decreased in July according to the Periodic Labour Force Survey. Joblessness increased in urban areas while it eased in rural regions.

India.title: 2 MBBS Interns Sexually Harassed At Haryana Medical College, Accused Arrested
India.summary: Two female MBBS interns were sexually harassed in separate incidents on a Haryana medical college campus last week. Police have arrested the accused following the complaints.

India.title: Foreigner On Mumbai-Delhi Train Sprays Fire Extinguisher, Dies During Probe
India.summary: A foreign national traveling on the Golden Temple Express from Mumbai to Delhi sprayed a fire extinguisher inside the train. The individual died while authorities were investigating the incident.

India.title: 5 Injured After Ferris Wheel Cabin Crashes At Lucknow Fair, 2 Critical
India.summary: Five people were injured, two critically, after a Ferris wheel cabin crashed at the Indiranagar Sawan Mahotsav in Lucknow. The accident occurred within the jurisdiction of the Ghazipur police station area.

India.title: NDTV Can Become India's Voice To World: Rahul Kanwal
India.summary: Rahul Kanwal stated that NDTV has the potential to become India's voice to the world. The CEO and Editor-in-Chief also described the network as the original pioneer of the country's digital ecosystem.

India.title: Over 2.07 Crore Voters Face SIR Exclusion In Maharashtra: Poll Body Data
India.summary: Maharashtra election data shows that over 2.07 million voters have been excluded under the ASDD category. The highest numbers of excluded voters are concentrated in Pune, Thane, and the Mumbai Suburban district.

India.title: US Envoy Sergio Gor To Meet Omar Abdullah During 2-Day J&K, Ladakh Visit
India.summary: US Special Envoy Sergio Gor is visiting Jammu, Kashmir, and Ladakh for two days. During his trip, he will meet with Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha.

General.title: Three dead after family get into difficulty in sea
General.summary: Three people died and a young girl is in critical condition after getting into difficulty while swimming off the Sussex coast. The victims include a man, a woman, and a teenage girl.

General.title: 'Everyone in for Christmas' - Burnham unveils rough sleeping plan
General.summary: Andy Burnham has unveiled a plan to offer housing to rough sleepers across England. This initiative is similar to the "Everyone In" program used during the COVID-19 pandemic.

General.title: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
General.summary: A British couple on their honeymoon was killed in a helicopter crash on a Greek island. The Greek pilot of the aircraft also died in the accident.

General.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, court hears
General.summary: A major US state lawsuit has begun against Meta, with allegations that the company intentionally hooked children on Facebook and Instagram. In its defense, Meta argued that social media addiction does not exist.

General.title: Burnham received £345,000 of donations ahead of becoming PM
General.summary: Prime Minister Burnham received £345,000 in donations before taking office. He disclosed these financial interests for the first time since returning to Parliament.

General.title: How soon will the drought be over?
General.summary: Recent rain has returned to parts of the UK this week. It remains uncertain whether this rainfall is sufficient to end the drought in affected regions.
